purpose: Project-recommended MCP servers for agents working in this repository.

consumerStatus.projectManifest: .agents/mcp-servers.json is a repository manifest. Keep its server names, commands, args, and URLs in parity with .codex/config.toml.
consumerStatus.codex: Use .codex/config.toml for this repository Codex MCP configuration; it must mirror this manifest without operating-system-specific launchers.
consumerStatus.antigravity: Antigravity/Gemini uses its own mcp_config.json format outside this manifest.
consumerStatus.jsonInterpolation: Do not assume ${ENV_VAR}, $ENV_VAR, or .env loading in this JSON. JSON has no interpolation by itself.

env.loadPolicy: Secrets stay in local .env. Each MCP client must load .env through its official mechanism, inherited process environment, or an explicit launcher.

policy.secrets: Never store API keys, PATs, OAuth tokens, or application-default credential files in this repository.
notes: Use these MCPs only when they help the current task.
Keep repository-intelligence MCPs out unless benchmark and security evidence is recorded in docs/AGENT_CONTEXT_EFFICIENCY_AUDIT.md.
Keep this manifest and .codex/config.toml operating-system neutral; do not use powershell.exe, cmd.exe, npx.cmd, bash, sh, or absolute OS-specific paths in committed MCP launch config.

context7.purpose: Fetch current library and framework documentation during coding tasks.

chrome-devtools.purpose: Inspect and automate Chrome DevTools for browser debugging and UI verification.

playwright.purpose: Inspect and automate existing tabs in the authenticated Chrome profile selected by the Playwright MCP extension token.

auth.secretStorage: Put PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXTENSION_TOKEN in local .env only and load it into the MCP client process environment; never commit its value.

github-readonly.purpose: Read GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and related metadata without write tools.

auth.secretStorage: Use the MCP client's OAuth/session storage; do not commit tokens.

gcloud.purpose: Use Google Cloud through the local gcloud CLI with the active gcloud identity.

prerequisites: Authenticate with gcloud auth login and application-default credentials when needed.

stitch.purpose: Use Google Stitch design workflows through a local MCP proxy, without Figma.

auth.secretStorage: Put secret values in local .env only. Do not put API keys in this JSON or in client MCP config files.
options: Run npx @_davideast/stitch-mcp init for guided setup.
Set STITCH_API_KEY in .env for API key auth only when needed.
Set STITCH_USE_SYSTEM_GCLOUD=false in .env to avoid system gcloud ADC when using API key auth.
Use existing Google Cloud CLI defaults only when intentionally using OAuth/ADC instead of STITCH_API_KEY.

browserPlugins.purpose: Control the user's authenticated Chrome session for visual inspection and interactive browser verification.

runtime.notes: The Chrome plugin owns its managed node_repl browser runtime. Do not add a duplicate raw Chrome MCP command to this manifest.

verification: Validate environment loading without printing secret values, for example by checking Boolean(process.env.STITCH_API_KEY).
Restart the MCP client after changing its active MCP config.
Use the MCP client server inspection command or UI to confirm active servers.
Confirm chrome@openai-bundled is enabled and its managed node_repl MCP runtime is active before using existing Chrome tabs.
